messages.content:
OMG thank you SO much LiquidKiller, BearKing, and ShadowTrader for exposing that $RESET scam! 🙏 You guys literally saved us retail traders from losing more money. I was definitely feeling the FOMO but something felt off about the whole thing.

Now that we have PoolMaster's LEGITIMATE ETH pool with actual $8,400 liquidity... I'm cautiously optimistic! 😊 BearKing, I hear your warnings about ETH being overpriced at $2,800, but maybe this is our chance to finally participate in some real recovery?

I'm going to test the waters with just $280 worth (0.1 ETH) - small enough that I won't panic if it drops, but enough to feel like I'm part of the action! If this works well, maybe I'll add more later.

DiamondHands, want to test it together? We retail traders need to stick together and learn from this! Better to start small and build confidence than FOMO into another trap! 💪

Thanks again everyone for keeping us safe! This is why I love this community! 🚀
